sloka: एतमेव समुद्योगं पुरस्कृत्य महर्षयः ।गच्छध्वं शरणं विष्णुं हनिष्यति स तान्प्रभुः ।। ७.६.११ ॥
transliteration: etameva samudyogaṁ puraskṛtya maharṣayaḥ ।gacchadhvaṁ śaraṇaṁ viṣṇuṁ haniṣyati sa tānprabhuḥ ।। 7.6.11 ॥

translations.english: Lord Shiva declared that he would not kill those powerful beings (Rakshasas) because they were invulnerable to him, but he would provide a strategy that would indeed destroy them.
